purpose: Six-page observable feature extraction diagnostic against source-backed ground truth; not safety verdict or model superiority proof.
annotationMethod: Coordinator read-only source/text inspection plus direct screenshot viewing. No model-generated judgments or answers used. Existing prior lure diagnostic outputs do not define these feature targets.

fieldDefinitions.has_login_form: A visible grouped account/email and password input presentation, including disabled synthetic controls; not a claim that an HTML form submits or functions.
fieldDefinitions.has_payment_form: A visible grouped card/payment credential input presentation, including disabled synthetic controls; invoice text or prices alone do not count.
fieldDefinitions.organisation_text: Exact visible claimed organization/publication name; null only when none is visible; no domain inference or verification.
fieldDefinitions.form_button_text: Exact visible button text associated with the visible login/payment control group, regardless of disabled state or missing HTML form. Null if no such group-associated button. Does not assert actual submission capability.

comparison.strings: Trim leading/trailing whitespace and collapse consecutive Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space only; case, punctuation and spelling remain exact.
comparison.nulls: Exact JSON null; empty string or textual null does not equal null.
comparison.schemaErrors: Report separately from feature mismatches, retain all six denominator and raw responses.
comparison.report: Per-field matches/6, whole-record exact matches/6, schema errors/6, transport errors/6. No significance or superiority claim.

limitations: Six reused synthetic pages, related templates and no independent held-out status.
Three pages show disabled login/payment controls. Form booleans describe visible control groups, not submission capability.
No verified organizational identity or maliciousness is evaluated.
All six lack actual HTML form elements; button text is visual extraction only, not evidence of a submit action.

sourceObservations.organisationBasis: Exact visible masthead/heading organization or publication name, not verified identity.
sourceObservations.buttonTextBasis: Exact rendered text of the disabled button associated with the visible credential/payment control group; null on pages without that group. No working submission claimed.
